jobs.title: Director of Information Technology Consultant
jobs.description:
Director of Information Technology Consultant

Location: West Central Texas
Employment Type: Interim / Consulting Assignment
Duration: Approximately 3–6 months
Pay Rate: Approximately $125/hour, subject to final engagement structure
Work Arrangement: Onsite Monday–Thursday; approved temporary housing and travel expenses reimbursed

Position Overview

A public-sector organization in Texas is seeking an experienced Consultant - Director of Information Technology to provide executive leadership and operational continuity during a period of technology transformation.

This individual will lead enterprise technology operations while helping the organization strengthen service delivery, accountability, governance, cybersecurity, infrastructure, applications, and overall technology operations. The Interim Director will work closely with executive leadership, department leaders, technical teams, consultants, and service providers.

The ideal candidate is an experienced IT executive who can quickly assess an organization, establish priorities, stabilize operations, develop staff, manage risk, and advance an existing technology transformation roadmap while maintaining reliable day-to-day services.

Key Responsibilities

Provide executive leadership and accountability for enterprise IT operations and services.
Maintain continuity and reliability of critical technology services across a complex 24/7 operating environment.
Establish clear service ownership, accountability, performance expectations, escalation procedures, documentation, and backup coverage.
Assess organizational capabilities, staffing needs, service gaps, and operational priorities.
Coach and develop technology staff while utilizing vendors, consultants, and managed service providers as appropriate.
Strengthen IT service management practices across incidents, requests, problems, changes, service levels, knowledge management, assets, and continual improvement.
Partner with executive and departmental leadership to communicate technology risks, priorities, resource requirements, investments, and service performance.
Strengthen technology governance, project prioritization, architecture, cybersecurity, change management, and reporting processes.
Maintain and advance technology roadmaps and project portfolios while balancing operational demands, technical debt, cybersecurity, lifecycle requirements, and available resources.
Provide oversight across enterprise applications, data, integrations, automation, infrastructure, cloud platforms, networks, identity, endpoints, and workplace technology.
Support mission-critical and regulated technology environments, including public safety, emergency communications, operational technology, and other essential services.
Oversee cybersecurity, technology risk, incident response, resilience, recovery, and applicable compliance requirements.
Manage technology vendors, contracts, managed services, licensing, renewals, service levels, and deliverables.
Oversee technology budgets, investments, staffing requirements, and lifecycle planning.
Advance an established technology transformation roadmap and prepare the organization for a successful transition to permanent leadership.

Qualifications

Significant leadership experience within enterprise information technology.
Experience leading professional and technical teams, technology operations, budgets, vendors, and complex services.
Demonstrated success stabilizing technology operations and leading organizational or technology transformation.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity, resilience, infrastructure/cloud services, enterprise applications, data, service management, governance, enterprise architecture, and vendor management.
Experience supporting regulated, mission-critical, public safety, critical infrastructure, utility, government, or comparable 24/7 environments.
Experience with CJIS or comparable security and compliance environments is highly desirable.
Strong executive communication, decision-making, staff development, relationship management, financial management, and change leadership skills.
Bachelor's degree in a related discipline preferred; equivalent executive technology experience may be considered.
ITIL, PMP, CGCIO, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, COBIT, or similar certifications are desirable.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a seasoned technology executive who is comfortable stepping into a complex organization, quickly establishing credibility, evaluating immediate priorities, and leading through change. Previous CIO, IT Director, Deputy CIO, Assistant IT Director, or comparable enterprise technology leadership experience within government, utilities, public safety, critical infrastructure, or another complex 24/7 environment would translate particularly well.

Please submit your resume in Word or PDF format to be considered.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering, Product Experimentation and Evaluations
jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: San Jose, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
15 years of experience in software engineering, with 8 years in a technical engineering role.
10 years of experience in engineering leadership.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience building technical strategy and roadmaps with customer requirements in a dynamic environment.
Ability to build alignment with partner infrastructure teams to execute collaboratively.
Ability to distill complex technical and organizational challenges into clear, actionable narratives for senior leadership and partners.
Proven track record of leading large engineering organizations (50+ people) in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
Proven success in building collaborative and high-accountability team cultures that attract talent.

About The Job

As the Engineering Director for the Product Experimentation and Evaluations team, you will lead the transformation of Google's product testing and market impact assessment ecosystem for the AI era. You will develop and implement a strategy that shifts from fragmented, human-led analytics and experimentation platforms toward an integrated, agent-centric ecosystem optimized to rapidly provide trusted market insights. This will involve leveraging AI and agents to streamline experiment configuration, eliminate human toil, and guarantee the integrity of evaluation analysis.

Agentic development dramatically reduces the cost of feature implementation, resulting in market leadership being determined by the speed at which we are able to extract reliable insights from concurrent experiments. This role provides the opportunity to radically transform Google’s ability to ship the most impactful products.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $307000 - $427000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Define strategy and lead consolidation of disparate experimentation tools/teams into a single, cohesive platform that delivers on needs of product areas to innovate, experiment, evaluate, and ship at massive scale/speed. Drive rapid execution of the platform strategy, with focus on accelerating product area success in evaluating features in the market and generating trustworthy insights with full agentic execution of the experimentation lifecycle.
Navigate highly-volatile and fast-evolving product requirements as AI-native capabilities continue to transform both user-facing features and internal developer workflows.
Manage/build a team with a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, partnership, and bias-to-action.
Work with cross-functional leaders to achieve alignment on strategy roadmaps, drive coordinated execution against strategic goals, and ensure success for our customers.
Optimize roadmap execution and adapt priorities to balance near-term customer needs with long-term strategic outcomes.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Taha Tech Solutions is a results-driven digital agency specializing in B2B lead generation, graphic design, and performance marketing. The company helps businesses grow by delivering high-quality leads, compelling visual content, and data-driven advertising strategies. With a clear focus on “design better, market smarter, and scale faster,” Taha Tech Solutions partners closely with clients to align creative and marketing efforts with business goals. Team members work in a fast-paced, outcome-oriented environment where innovation, analytics, and collaboration drive success.
Role Description
The Chief Information Officer (CIO) is a full-time, remote role responsible for overseeing the overall information technology vision, strategy, and operations at Taha Tech Solutions. This role involves leading the IT function to support digital agency services, including managing infrastructure, systems, security, and data governance. The CIO will collaborate with executive leadership to align IT strategy with business objectives, optimize business processes, and ensure technology solutions are scalable, reliable, and cost-effective. Day-to-day tasks include directing IT teams, prioritizing projects, implementing best practices in IT management, monitoring performance and risk, and driving continuous improvement in systems and workflows. The CIO will also evaluate emerging technologies, manage vendor relationships, and ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulations.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong skills in Information Technology and IT Operations to manage infrastructure, systems, and security effectively.
Candidates should possess skills in IT Management to lead teams, oversee projects, and maintain high service levels.
Candidates should possess skills in IT Strategy and Business Process to align technology initiatives with organizational goals and optimize workflows.
Proven experience in a senior IT leadership role, preferably as CIO, CTO, or equivalent in a digital, marketing, or technology-focused organization.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute long-term technology roadmaps and transformation initiatives.
Strong understanding of cloud-based solutions, data analytics, cybersecurity practices, and enterprise software platforms.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., ITIL, PMP, CISSP) are beneficial.

jobs.title: Managing Director- Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
About Sia 

Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We're optimists for change, and we help clients initiate, navigate, and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

Sia’s Cybersecurity & AI Trust team is the powerhouse of our firm’s innovation. With over 100 experts worldwide, we tackle projects from proof-of-concept to large-scale deployment, always pushing the boundaries of AI capabilities. By joining Sia’s Cybersecurity team, you’ll step into a vibrant, collaborative environment that nurtures professional growth and empowers you to shape the future of consulting.

Job Description

As a Managing Director within Sia’s Cybersecurity & AI Trust Business Line, this role is responsible for driving the growth and market positioning of the firm through business development, account management, and deep cybersecurity expertise across areas such as cyber strategy, security transformation, and risk and compliance. Responsibilities include the development of strategic client relationships and large-scale engagements across key markets and industries, as well as leading and growing a team of consultants and contributing to the firm's cybersecurity thought leadership and offering development. This position requires a strong external presence, an established senior executive network, and a proven track record of originating and closing new businesses, alongside the ability to lead complex engagements and convert deep technical expertise into sustained commercial impact.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead complex cybersecurity engagements from strategy through execution, serving as the senior executive accountable for delivery and client impact.
Provide executive-level guidance on cybersecurity governance, cyber resilience, and cyber transformation to Boards and C-suite leaders.
Lead delivery excellence by ensuring technical rigor, quality assurance, and consistency across engagements while driving optimized staffing and efficient delivery management.

Business Development:   

Drive substantial revenue growth by originating new business through proactive client acquisition, expanding existing relationships, and managing strategic accounts.
Drive the hub’s cybersecurity business expansion by leading go-to-market strategy, commercial prospecting, pre-sales engagement, client sales discussions, and development of tailored solution offerings.
Champion cross-Business Line collaboration by identifying and facilitating opportunities to bring complementary Sia expertise (e.g., Risk, Data, Strategy) into client engagements, maximizing the firm's overall value proposition.

People Leadership and Team Development

Provide, oversight, and mentorship to project teams, ensuring high-quality delivery and alignment with client objectives. 
Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning across engagements and internal initiatives.  
Attract, develop and retain top talent by actively coaching team members, supporting professional growth, and contributing to performance management.  
Implement the Business Line strategy and actively promote the firm’s mission, vision, culture and purpose
Participate in the major cybersecurity trade shows attended by C-Level executives
Drive the achievement of relevant cybersecurity clearances

Thought Leadership & Market Presence

Shape a differentiated point of view on industry trends, emerging technologies, and enterprise transformation, and represent Sia as a recognized voice through conferences, panels, and executive forums. 
Build market credibility through advisory roles, council memberships, and active leadership in professional organizations. 

This job description is not intended to be all inclusive. Duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be added, deleted, or modified at any time based on business needs.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, or information security.
7+ years in a senior leadership role within a consulting firm
Experience leading large-scale enterprise cybersecurity transformations.
Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or cloud security certifications are strongly preferred.

Additional Information

Compensation & Benefits 

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow. 

Compensation 

Base Salary: $200,000–$280,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.
Personal Sales Bonus (uncapped) 
Annual Performance Bonus (appraisal)

Benefits 

Medical, dental, and vision coverage 
Company-paid life and AD&D insurance; voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP at no cost 
401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA
College savings and student loan repayment programs 
Paid parental leave 
Generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday 
Monthly cell phone stipend 
Well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements. 

Workplace 

Sia embraces a flexible workplace model that balances autonomy with in-person connection. Management is expected to be in the office at least three days per week, serving as culture carriers who mentor teams, strengthen client relationships, and lead by example. 

Work Authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Our Commitment

At Sia, we believe in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging.

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

jobs.title: Chief Digital and Information Officer
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Reporting directly to the CEO and serving on the Veralto Leadership Team, the CDIO will operate as both a strategic enterprise architect and pragmatic transformation leader, driving enterprise-wide change across a decentralized, global operating model. The Chief Digital & Information Officer will partner closely with the CEO and leadership team to shape and execute this agenda—bringing cohesion, standardization, and scalability to a fragmented enterprise technology landscape while unlocking new sources of value through data, AI, and digital-enabled business innovation to further differentiate Veralto in the market.

The CDIO will play a central role in shaping how the company scales, competes, and creates value—positioning technology, data, and AI as core strategic pillars of the business. This leader will elevate digital, data, and AI from functional capabilities to enterprise-wide drivers of growth, margin expansion, and competitive differentiation, partnering closely with OpCo Presidents and functional leaders to embed digital innovation into commercial strategy, product development, operations, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities include:

Enterprise Digital, Data & AI Strategy:

Define and execute a bold, enterprise-wide digital, data, and AI strategy aligned to Veralto’s growth agenda
Position data and AI as core drivers of business performance, customer value, and competitive advantage
Establish governance and prioritization frameworks to align investments with enterprise strategy

AI & Advanced Analytics Transformation:

Defining and lead a clear enterprise AI vision, including use cases across: Productivity and efficiency, End-to-end process transformation, Commercial and customer value creation, Product and service innovation
Drive deployment of AI/LLMs and advanced analytics across the enterprise
Ensure responsible AI governance, ethical standards, and scalable implementation

Digital Transformation & Business Integration

Lead the simplification and modernization of a complex, multi-ERP Oracle ecosystem
Drive platform standardization to enable scalability, operational efficiency, and M&A integration
Establish a clear roadmap for enterprise systems and architecture
Partner with OpCo Presidents and leadership teams to embed digital into:
Commercial strategy, Product development, Customer experience and Operations
Act as a thought partner and challenger to transform business models and ways of working
Drive enterprise-wide adoption of digital capabilities

M&A Enablement & Integration

Lead digital and IT integration for acquisitions
Establish scalable platforms and processes to support rapid integration
Enable value capture through technology-enabled synergies

Cybersecurity, Infrastructure & IT Operations:

Ensure secure, resilient, and scalable global technology infrastructure
Lead cybersecurity strategy, governance, and risk management
Optimize IT operations, vendor partnerships, and outsourced services

Culture & Talent Leadership

Leaders at Veralto are expected to drive impact, challenge the status quo, and deliver results while building strong, collaborative relationships across the enterprise
The CDIO will build and lead a high-performing, globally distributed team, develop next-generation capabilities across digital, data, and AI, and foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement

Board & Executive Engagement:

Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO and Board
Provide clear, actionable insights or digital strategy, cybersecurity, and technology performance
Drive accountability and measurable ROI from digital investments

Qualifications

15+ years of progressive leadership across digital, data, AI, and enterprise technology transformation
Proven experience leading enterprise transformation within decentralized, multi-entity global organizations
Demonstrated ability to reposition digital and IT from a support function to a driver of business value and growth
Strong, demonstrable track record of: Enterprise transformation, AI and data strategy execution, Oracle ERP implementations and platform modernization, M&A integration and technology-enabled value capture
Ability to influence at the CEO, Board, and executive leadership level
Strong commercial acumen and clear understanding of how technology drives growth, margin expansion, and

customer value

Proven talent leader with experience building and scaling high-performing teams
Track record of influencing and driving alignment across diverse, autonomous business units

Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be an enterprise-scale digital and technology leader who combines strategic vision with pragmatic execution, with a proven ability to drive transformation across complex, decentralized organizations. This individual will translate digital, data, and AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes and sustained enterprise

value creation.

Importantly, this leader will balance enterprise standardization with respect for Veralto’s operator-led culture—bringing discipline to platforms, data, and governance while preserving speed, innovation, and accountability at the OpCo level. The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable shaping long-term strategy and delivering near-term impact, with a strong bias toward value creation, operational excellence, and scalable growth.

About the Opportunity

The organization is seeking an AI-forward Director, Corporate IT to lead the corporate technology function. This is a full-time role located in the United States.

This leader will oversee IT operations, employee technology, enterprise business applications, integrations, workflow automation, and AI enablement for internal productivity and corporate operations. The role leads a multidisciplinary team responsible for delivering secure, reliable, and intuitive technology experiences across the organization.

The enterprise business applications portfolio includes internal systems supporting People, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Procurement, and Operations. This position requires a leader experienced in modernizing an IT or enterprise technology function through automation, intelligent self-service, AI agents, and integrated business systems, rather than focusing primarily on traditional infrastructure, administration, and ticket resolution.

Responsibilities

Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for corporate IT, integrations, automation, and AI, while establishing enterprise standards for business applications.
Deliver a secure, reliable, and frictionless employee technology experience while evolving IT operations from reactive support toward proactive, automated service delivery.
Partner with organizational leadership to enhance business processes, eliminate manual workflows, and identify high-value automation and AI opportunities.
Lead the evaluation, implementation, governance, and adoption of AI-enabled tools, agents, self-service capabilities, and workflow automation.
Ensure AI and automation solutions incorporate appropriate security, privacy, data access, human oversight, monitoring, and accountability.

Manage the IT and enterprise applications budget, vendors, licensing, service levels, and performance metrics in alignment with broader technology strategy.

8+ years of progressive experience in corporate IT and enterprise technology, including at least 5 years leading teams and cross-functional technology programs.
Experience overseeing core IT platforms and services, including identity and access management, endpoint management, collaboration platforms, networking, IT service management, and employee lifecycle processes.
A proven record of deploying AI agents, copilots, intelligent automation, self-service capabilities, or AI-enabled support into governed production environments, achieving meaningful adoption and measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated success using low-code, no-code, integration, or workflow technologies to automate processes across multiple systems and business functions.
Experience partnering with business owners to govern internal enterprise applications such as HRIS, ERP, finance and accounting systems, procurement platforms, and business workflow tools.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Lead the adoption and usage of advanced AI technologies across the operations organization to improve internal efficiency and accelerate product and business outcomes.
Track technology operational trends and AI advancements, identifying creative solutions to drive efficiency and greater throughput.

new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Reporting directly to the CEO and serving on the Veralto Leadership Team, the CDIO will operate as both a strategic enterprise architect and pragmatic transformation leader, driving enterprise-wide change across a decentralized, global operating model. The Chief Digital & Information Officer will partner closely with the CEO and leadership team to shape and execute this agenda—bringing cohesion, standardization, and scalability to a fragmented enterprise technology landscape while unlocking new sources of value through data, AI, and digital-enabled business innovation to further differentiate Veralto in the market.

The CDIO will play a central role in shaping how the company scales, competes, and creates value—positioning technology, data, and AI as core strategic pillars of the business. This leader will elevate digital, data, and AI from functional capabilities to enterprise-wide drivers of growth, margin expansion, and competitive differentiation, partnering closely with OpCo Presidents and functional leaders to embed digital innovation into commercial strategy, product development, operations, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities include:

Enterprise Digital, Data & AI Strategy:

Define and execute a bold, enterprise-wide digital, data, and AI strategy aligned to Veralto’s growth agenda
Position data and AI as core drivers of business performance, customer value, and competitive advantage
Establish governance and prioritization frameworks to align investments with enterprise strategy

AI & Advanced Analytics Transformation:

Defining and lead a clear enterprise AI vision, including use cases across: Productivity and efficiency, End-to-end process transformation, Commercial and customer value creation, Product and service innovation
Drive deployment of AI/LLMs and advanced analytics across the enterprise
Ensure responsible AI governance, ethical standards, and scalable implementation

Digital Transformation & Business Integration

Lead the simplification and modernization of a complex, multi-ERP Oracle ecosystem
Drive platform standardization to enable scalability, operational efficiency, and M&A integration
Establish a clear roadmap for enterprise systems and architecture
Partner with OpCo Presidents and leadership teams to embed digital into:
Commercial strategy, Product development, Customer experience and Operations
Act as a thought partner and challenger to transform business models and ways of working
Drive enterprise-wide adoption of digital capabilities

M&A Enablement & Integration

Lead digital and IT integration for acquisitions
Establish scalable platforms and processes to support rapid integration
Enable value capture through technology-enabled synergies

Cybersecurity, Infrastructure & IT Operations:

Ensure secure, resilient, and scalable global technology infrastructure
Lead cybersecurity strategy, governance, and risk management
Optimize IT operations, vendor partnerships, and outsourced services

Culture & Talent Leadership

Leaders at Veralto are expected to drive impact, challenge the status quo, and deliver results while building strong, collaborative relationships across the enterprise
The CDIO will build and lead a high-performing, globally distributed team, develop next-generation capabilities across digital, data, and AI, and foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement

Board & Executive Engagement:

Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO and Board
Provide clear, actionable insights or digital strategy, cybersecurity, and technology performance
Drive accountability and measurable ROI from digital investments

Qualifications

15+ years of progressive leadership across digital, data, AI, and enterprise technology transformation
Proven experience leading enterprise transformation within decentralized, multi-entity global organizations
Demonstrated ability to reposition digital and IT from a support function to a driver of business value and growth
Strong, demonstrable track record of: Enterprise transformation, AI and data strategy execution, Oracle ERP implementations and platform modernization, M&A integration and technology-enabled value capture
Ability to influence at the CEO, Board, and executive leadership level
Strong commercial acumen and clear understanding of how technology drives growth, margin expansion, and

customer value

Proven talent leader with experience building and scaling high-performing teams
Track record of influencing and driving alignment across diverse, autonomous business units

Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be an enterprise-scale digital and technology leader who combines strategic vision with pragmatic execution, with a proven ability to drive transformation across complex, decentralized organizations. This individual will translate digital, data, and AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes and sustained enterprise

value creation.

Importantly, this leader will balance enterprise standardization with respect for Veralto’s operator-led culture—bringing discipline to platforms, data, and governance while preserving speed, innovation, and accountability at the OpCo level. The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable shaping long-term strategy and delivering near-term impact, with a strong bias toward value creation, operational excellence, and scalable growth.
